data.narrative:
Agile Robots is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Zhaopeng Chen and Peter Meusel, currently valued above $1B after raising approximately $384M. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable, all operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Peer-median analysis, the primary applicable method, identifies a cohort of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B, Series C). This peer set yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The presence of two Series C peers valued at $1.0B and $1.6B provides particular relevance to stage positioning.

Triangulation across available methods supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.9B, with a median of $1.6B. This range is consistent with the target's stated valuation above $1B. Key uncertainties include the limited dataset (single applicable method) and stage heterogeneity within the peer set, which spans Series B through Series D. Additional revenue-based or transaction-derived inputs would strengthen conviction in this range.
